tools.name: read_file
tools.description: Read the contents of a text file from the filesystem

parameters.name: file_path
parameters.description: Path to the file to read

parameters.name: max_lines
parameters.description: Maximum number of lines to read (optional, reads all if not specified)

tools.name: write_file
tools.description: Write content to a file (creates or overwrites)

parameters.name: file_path
parameters.description: Path to the file to write

parameters.name: content
parameters.description: Content to write to the file

parameters.name: append
parameters.description: If true, append to file instead of overwriting

tools.name: list_directory
tools.description: List files and subdirectories in a directory

parameters.name: dir_path
parameters.description: Path to the directory to list

parameters.name: recursive
parameters.description: If true, list all files recursively

tools.name: find_files
tools.description: Find files matching a pattern in current directory and subdirectories (glob-style: *.py, test*, etc.)

parameters.name: pattern
parameters.description: Glob-style pattern to match filenames (e.g., '*.py', 'test*', '*.txt')

parameters.name: search_path
parameters.description: Directory to search in (defaults to current directory, restricted to CWD and children)

parameters.name: max_results
parameters.description: Maximum number of results to return (default 100)

tools.name: fetch_url
tools.description: Fetch content from a URL (http/https only, blocks local networks)

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: URL to fetch (must be http:// or https://)

parameters.name: timeout
parameters.description: Request timeout in seconds (default 10)

parameters.name: max_size_mb
parameters.description: Maximum content size in MB (default 10)

tools.name: edit_file
tools.description: Edit a file by replacing a specific string (creates backup, shows diff, string must appear exactly once)

parameters.name: file_path
parameters.description: Path to the file to edit

parameters.name: old_string
parameters.description: String to find and replace (must appear exactly once in file)

parameters.name: new_string
parameters.description: String to replace with

tools.name: list_backups
tools.description: List available file backups (created by edit_file)

parameters.name: file_name
parameters.description: Filter backups by original filename (optional)

tools.name: restore_backup
tools.description: Restore a file from backup (shows diff, creates backup of current state before restoring)

parameters.name: backup_path
parameters.description: Path to the backup file (from list_backups)

tools.name: grep
tools.description: Search for a pattern in a file (regex supported)

parameters.name: pattern
parameters.description: Pattern to search for (regex)

parameters.name: file_path
parameters.description: File to search in

parameters.name: ignore_case
parameters.description: Case-insensitive search (default false)

parameters.name: context
parameters.description: Number of context lines before/after match (default 0)

tools.name: diff
tools.description: Compare two files and show differences

parameters.name: file1
parameters.description: First file to compare

parameters.name: file2
parameters.description: Second file to compare

parameters.name: unified
parameters.description: Use unified diff format (default true)

tools.name: wc
tools.description: Count lines, words, and characters in a file

parameters.name: file_path
parameters.description: File to analyze

tools.name: head
tools.description: Show the first N lines of a file

parameters.name: file_path
parameters.description: File to read

parameters.name: lines
parameters.description: Number of lines to show (default 10)

tools.name: tail
tools.description: Show the last N lines of a file

parameters.name: file_path
parameters.description: File to read

parameters.name: lines
parameters.description: Number of lines to show (default 10)

tools.name: get_news_headlines
tools.description: Fetch latest news headlines from searxng (auto-deduplicates similar headlines)

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Search query for news (default: 'breaking news')

parameters.name: max_results
parameters.description: Maximum number of headlines to return (default 10)

tools.name: get_datetime
tools.description: Get the current date and time in various formats (full/date/time/timestamp)

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: Format type: 'full' (default), 'date', 'time', or 'timestamp'

tools.name: web_search
tools.description: Search the internet using multiple sources with built-in fact-checking. Searches SearXNG (metasearch engine) and Wikipedia for factual queries. Returns results with confidence ratings based on source agreement. Use this to find current information, verify facts, or research topics. Especially useful for factual queries about people, events, statistics, and current affairs.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: The search query. Can be a question or keywords.

parameters.name: max_results
parameters.description: Maximum number of results to return (1-20, default: 5)

parameters.name: check_facts
parameters.description: Whether to perform fact-checking and source verification (default: true)

tools.name: create_directory
tools.description: Create a new directory (like mkdir). Creates parent directories by default if they don't exist.

parameters.name: dir_path
parameters.description: Path to the directory to create

parameters.name: parents
parameters.description: If true, create parent directories as needed (default true)
